title: Microsoft Copilot: Word Agent drafts long-form Word documents through chat
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing conflict, Anthropic dependency, December deadline and governance controls are supported. Minor corrections should qualify the regional default statement and expand the abbreviated checklist paths.

claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences. When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.
